newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian zinc, nickel rise, shortage boosts prices.
newsitem.headline: Indian zinc, nickel rise, shortage boosts prices.

text.p: Indian zinc and nickel prices on Thursday gained while other base metals were steady in local markets with world markets showing a rise, dealers said.
Zinc prices rose by 50 rupees to 7,150 rupees per quintal against a shortage of ready stock as well as fresh speculative buying on the back of an overseas uptrend.
"Physical buying however remained low today. This may trigger light profit-taking," one dealer said.
Zinc was up by 50 rupees on Wednesday.
Nickel gained by 100 rupees to 37,200 rupees per quintal on fresh support. It was down by 100 rupees on Wednesday.
Copper held steady at the reduced level of 12,900 rupees on slow trade. "Rising global prices may sent up local prices," the dealer said.
Aluminium was unchanged at 7,250 rupees per quintal, lead at 4,550 rupees and tin at 34,100 rupees in a narrow price band amid limited activity.
